title: Sentry
description: Opt-in errors, traces, logs, metrics and browser monitoring for your own Sentry project.

SENTRY_ENABLED.description: Enable this server's Sentry integration. Install the sentry plugin before enabling; restart the server after configuration changes.

SENTRY_DSN.description: DSN for your Sentry project. No shared or built-in destination is provided.

SENTRY_RELEASE.description: Release identifier; empty uses the Sentry SDK's release detection.

SENTRY_PROFILE_SESSION_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Fraction of server processes collecting CPU profiles using the configured lifecycle. Zero disables profiling; restart after changes.

SENTRY_PROFILE_LIFECYCLE.description: Profile only while spans are active (trace), or continuously for the enabled process lifetime (manual). Manual mode also covers worker work whose EventBus spans are exported after completion.

SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII.description: Include default personally identifiable information such as authenticated user details.

SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Fraction of Django, HTTP, SQL, browser and EventBus traces sampled. Zero disables performance tracing.

SENTRY_ENABLE_LOGS.description: Also send Python log records to Sentry Logs. Error events and breadcrumbs work without this.

SENTRY_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum level for breadcrumbs and optional Sentry Logs, subject to the host logger's own level. ERROR and CRITICAL records always create error events.

SENTRY_ENABLE_METRICS.description: Send span counts and duration distributions, plus browser page-load metrics.

SENTRY_BROWSER_ENABLED.description: When Sentry is enabled on this machine, load the browser SDK for UI exceptions, tracing, logs and metrics. Session replay is never enabled.
